compiler_build_scope: ZLLVM_EXE supplies ReleaseFast to the integration hook and explicitly selected whole-program routes: five fixed Zig programs, migrate_langref and the input-driven C corpus. Ordinary/native builds and legacy hello-libc/upstream-C routes use installed Debug. Core runners are separately built. Full acceptance rebuilds Debug from the same frozen source after cache cleanup.

unchanged_zig_input_program.oracle: Independently authored document/source contents and exact diagnostics from the pinned markup contract; LLVM is a second comparison, not the source of expected results. Negative controls mutate observations only.
remaining_dependencies: single-threaded Zig startup; error-return tracing disabled in both routes

c_input_program.mode_scope: Three local release pipelines; C assertions enabled and C sanitizers disabled.
c_input_program.oracle: Frozen expected observations, constructed from typed values and the upstream display format; error expectations from its explicit EOF handling. LLVM must satisfy these independently.
remaining_dependencies: Pinned Zig C frontend and LLVM IR construction
Clang 22 independent optimization and code generation
System linker, CRT and libc allocation/stdio

validation.cache_replay: all 36 canonical records match prior fresh execution
validation.independent_corpus_observations: all 174 actual observations match the independent manifest and focused run
validation.focused_code_identity: production, tool, build and test bytes match the focused source snapshot

backend_repairs.repair: Typed boolean-call actions accept runtime pointer arguments through shared pointer materialization and transaction preservation/rollback.
Choose zero for integer atomicrmw undef operands while retaining the atomic operation and its defined old-memory result.
Accept scalar i64/i128 ctpop without an optional range return attribute; existing lowering and unsupported-form checks remain.

workload_scope.coverage: Runtime filename arguments, allocation, mutation, growable lists, document parsing, generated files, parser and filesystem errors.
workload_scope.boundary: Emitted definitions are not executed-function counts. Observation controls do not mutate compiler implementations.

known_boundaries: Single-threaded baseline x86-64 Linux. Error-return tracing is disabled in both routes for stable diagnostics; no OOM injection, concurrency or panic-trace coverage.
LLVM IR construction, Zig linker/compiler-rt and libc/CRT remain dependencies.
Compiler phase timings are individual full-gate observations, not controlled speedup measurements or generated-code performance claims.
Independent ownership replay retains substantial duplicate selection work.
Optional legalization retains ordered scans and original-form retries; pair/vector PHIs, spill destinations and ordinary CLI structural selection retain existing paths.

cleanup.limitation: Caches regenerate. Unrelated filesystem activity also released space; free-space increase is not all attributed to this cleanup.

retention.sampling: Serial-run minimum and peak fields describe gate-boundary samples. An additional interactive df spot check during the final native suite observed 51,706,810,368 bytes free. Neither establishes a continuous filesystem minimum.
